question: Qwen3.8-27B (NVFP4) 在 RULER Multi-needle K=1 任务（128K 上下文）上的 Recall@1 基线值，需在 vLLM 部署下实测获得，预期范围 85%-95%（基于同参数量级模型在短上下文下的表现外推，长上下文通常下降 5-10%） [时效待核]

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B | NVIDIA NGC
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a 27-billion-parameter dense vision-language model for text, image, and video understanding. It supports coding, professional-work and research workflows, multimodal reasoning, configurable thinking depth, long-context processing, tool calling, and multi-step agentic tasks. This model is ready for commercial or non-commercial use.
